skills.name: management-translation
skills.changes: bounded delivery evidence into the smallest audience-specific management artifact without changing facts risk or decision ownership
skills.trigger: a delivery state risk milestone or decision needs concise management communication
minimum: Feature Delivery Case or management question
outputs: specialist selection and traceable management artifact

skills.name: executive-feature-brief
skills.changes: Feature Delivery Case evidence into a one-page brief covering purpose delivered state next milestone material risk quantified evidence and required decision
skills.trigger: a feature needs a weekly milestone portfolio or leadership brief
outputs: executive feature brief and structured record

skills.name: risk-escalation-packet
skills.changes: an unresolved blocker conflict or material risk into a decision-ready escalation with impact options recommendation timing and no-decision consequence
skills.trigger: the current team lacks authority to resolve a consequential blocker or risk

skills.name: audience-adapted-management-update
skills.changes: one authoritative evidence base into an audience-appropriate brief oral update risk package or decision record with explicit omissions
skills.trigger: the same delivery facts need different management projections by audience channel or time limit
outputs: audience-adapted management update and source mapping
